countercurrent.title: Gill lamella: flip the blood
countercurrent.concurrentNote: Same direction: water and blood rush to a shared, middling balance and stop — the slope dies at the halfway mark and the leftover oxygen drifts past untaken.
countercurrent.countercurrentNote: Opposed: the blood always meets water fresher than itself, so the slope holds the whole length of the frond — oxygen is taken right to the end.

breathingMode.title: Two ways to breathe, one problem
breathingMode.tidalNote: Tidal: air in and back out the same door, leaving a pocket of stale air that never clears; every breath stops and reverses a heavy mass of gas. In Pandora's dense air, that cost is steep.
breathingMode.unidirectionalNote: One-way: air streams a single direction across an always-fresh surface, never pausing, never reversing. Forward-facing intakes let the animal's own speed do the pumping — almost free.

steps.label: Luciferin + O₂
steps.body: The enzyme luciferase takes a small fuel molecule — luciferin — and joins it to oxygen. No light yet; this is only loading the chamber.

steps.label: High-energy intermediate
steps.body: Oxidation builds a strained peroxide ring (a dioxetanone). When the ring snaps, it sheds CO₂ and kicks the product up into an excited electronic state.

steps.label: Photon
steps.body: The excited electron drops back to its ground state. The whole energy difference leaves as a single particle of light — with almost no waste heat. That is cold light.

photophore.title: Na'vi photophores: tuned to the body
photophore.note: The dots sit along the vascular and neural lines, in bilateral pairs. They do not blink — they glow steadily, then flare as adrenaline rises (combat, bonding) and dim at rest.
photophore.mono: The light is monochrome blue-white. The 'colour change' people think they see is an illusion of changing intensity, or firelight reflecting off the skin.

glowBiogeography.title: Where glow happens — and why
glowBiogeography.insight: One rule, flipped: bioluminescence floods wherever it is chronically dim and a visual signal pays. On Earth that is the deep sea; dim Polyphemus-lit nights turn Pandora's land into the deep sea too.

glowOriginsTree.title: One trick, invented dozens of times
glowOriginsTree.hint: Tap a branch to see its own fuel and enzyme.
glowOriginsTree.note: Each branch glows with a different fuel molecule and a different enzyme. They did not inherit light from a shared glowing ancestor — every lineage stumbled onto it on its own.
